_comment: Career tiers. Every challenge in a tier must be done to move up, and reaching a tier lets you buy that tier's cars (the `tier` field in data/cars/cars.json; tier 1 here is index 0). Stat names are listed at the top of scripts/autoload/progression.gd. Targets follow the plan's pacing (first new car after 4-6 hours, first Abarth 12-15, tier 4 cars 35-40, the rest 60+); check changes with `python3 tools/pacing_model.py`.
